title: Squid Game
event_title: Squid Game is released on Netflix
lede: A Korean survival drama that became Netflix's biggest show, followed from what viewers looked up to what they borrowed.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Squid Game: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order, not proof that the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly)
